entries.goal: Set the 3-rung retry backoff schedule in hours for subscription payment failures (subscription retry schedule, renewal retry policy, dunning schedule, backoff hours).
entries.whyThisDefault: Twenty-four, 72, and 168 hours preserve the historical 3-rung retry cadence (retries on days 1, 4, and 11 after the initial decline) across both 3-argument subscription_retry_apply_failure and provider-recorded failures applied through payment_provider_result_apply without explicit p_cadence.

effect.appliesTo: Subsequent failure recordings via 3-argument subscription_retry_apply_failure and provider-recorded renewal failures via payment_provider_result_apply when p_cadence is omitted or NULL read key='subscription_retry_schedule' from public.commerce_settings via subscription_retry_schedule_read(). Explicit p_cadence passed to 4-argument subscription_retry_apply_failure or 12-argument payment_provider_result_apply takes precedence. When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to [24, 72, 168]; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 subscription_retry_schedule_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Already recorded subscription_retry_obligations next_retry_at schedules, completed subscription_retry_receipts (including idempotent replays), and already opened subscription_dunning_cases keep their recorded retry timestamps.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installSubscriptionRetrySchedulePolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and backoffHours. Revision must be a nonblank string and backoffHours an array of exactly three integers from 1 through 2147483647.

entries.goal: Use the same delivery controls for managed and native notices.

runtime.reason: Managed and native delivery paths use separate controls.

entries.goal: Compute target variant quantities from daily need, cadence, and portion factor during sized subscription portion changes (portion proposal, resize bundle, sized editor).
entries.whyThisDefault: The platform provides no default demand-to-quantity sizing formula; hosts supply SizedHostPorts.proposePortion from @openlup/platform/subscriptions, or refuse demand-driven resizing when unconfigured.

effect.appliesTo: New sized subscription portion-mode edits invoke SizedHostPorts.proposePortion from @openlup/platform/subscriptions before quoting and persisting updated lines.
frozenOn: Existing subscriptions and completed edit receipts retain their agreed lines and prices until a new edit is applied.

runtime.reason: The callback is executable server code implementing SizedHostPorts.proposePortion from @openlup/platform/subscriptions.

entries.goal: Set the stock hold lifetime when a renewal leaves stock wait.

runtime.reason: Native stock-wait recovery fixes the hold at 15 minutes in SQL. The separate reservation port reads holdSeconds from its own reserve call, outside native stock-wait recovery. The starter's scheduled renewal uses this port to expire reservations and leaves its holdSeconds option unused.

entries.goal: Set windows for subscriber review requests.

runtime.reason: Review branches exist in SQL and need composition before exposing a setting.

entries.goal: Reconcile unknown payment outcomes before retrying and stop on hard declines.

runtime.reason: Retrying a charge with an unknown outcome risks charging twice.

entries.goal: Send winback again for a new cancellation episode.

runtime.reason: The native winback receipt deduplicates by subscription.

entries.goal: Choose localRateTable or the opt-in stripeTax adapter bound to TaxCalculationPort in application composition.

absentMeans.description: Exclusive tax calculation requires an explicit binding for the selected scope, market and currency.

entries.whyThisDefault: The application owns the market and account for its tax calculations.

effect.appliesTo: The bound TaxCalculationPort supplies amounts, coverage decisions and evidence for new exclusive tax quotes.
frozenOn: Existing calculations keep their adapter scope and evidence.

runtime.reason: Change the binding in application composition and qualify it with the offline conformance kit.

entries.goal: Map application tax classes to provider tax codes in the versioned market pack.

absentMeans.description: An unmapped class refuses the quote before provider I/O.

entries.whyThisDefault: Each market pack owns the mapping for its catalogue and provider.

effect.appliesTo: New evaluations use the provider code for each frozen tax class.
frozenOn: Existing receipts retain their class-map revision and calculation evidence.

runtime.reason: Version the taxCodes mapping and classMapRevision passed in the adapter's market pack.

entries.goal: Record and inspect merchant tax coverage declarations by jurisdiction, tax kind and effective dates.

absentMeans.description: No coverage revisions have been installed for the selected account.

entries.whyThisDefault: The merchant declares its coverage explicitly.

effect.appliesTo: The installed history records the merchant's coverage for the selected account.
frozenOn: Previous declarations retain their original revisions and operator references.

runtime.reason: Tax coverage history is available on qualified native PostgreSQL installations through a host-bound reader. Managed installations do not supply this capability. Applying the native forward makes history available for installation and inspection. Tax checkout consumption is qualified separately.

change.reference: @openlup/platform README, Install and inspect tax coverage

rules.description: Supply the documented declaration or request shape. Use nonoverlapping intervals for each jurisdiction and tax kind, and include an acknowledgement reference for declarations of non-registration.

entries.goal: Supply effective rules for each jurisdiction, tax class and kind when binding the local rate table.

absentMeans.description: A missing effective rule refuses the quote, including on zero-priced components.

entries.whyThisDefault: Each application supplies its own effective rules and legal basis.

effect.appliesTo: localRateTable uses effective intervals, exact decimal-percent rates, explicit exemptions, or fixed fees with refund rules. It applies half-up rounding with largest-remainder allocation and carries the table digest in calculation evidence.
frozenOn: Existing calculations keep their recorded amounts, rules and evidence.

runtime.reason: Version the LocalRateTableOptionsV1 rules and registration evidence in the pack or application composition.
